name: Trung Hau
tagline: Video, photography and post-production for brands, events and digital communication.
workIntro: A selection of moving images, photography and the work in between.
portraitsIntro: A closer look at portraits and the finishing touches.
bio: I’m Trung Hau, also known as HEW — a videographer and video editor based in Ho Chi Minh City.
My work spans video, photography and post-production, with experience in media and marketing roles as well as freelance projects.

approach.title: Plan
approach.body: Start with the purpose, audience and format. Bring the idea into a clear visual direction.

approach.title: Produce
approach.body: Build the story frame by frame, with attention to composition, light and the moment.

approach.title: Finish
approach.body: Shape the rhythm in the edit. Refine the image and prepare it for its final format.
